question: On the DOOR page, what does an amber REGUL LO PR mean?

options.text: The cabin pressure is low
The door seal pressure is low
The oxygen pressure in the low-pressure circuit is low
The slide bottle pressure is low

explanation: The DOOR page also shows the crew oxygen bottle pressure.
reference: Study use only. Verify against the FCOM of your operator and aircraft before relying on it.

question: When is CKPT OXY shown in amber on the DOOR page?

options.text: When the oxygen pressure is low or CREW SUPPLY is off
When a mask is in use
When the oxygen bottle is full
When the passenger masks have dropped

reference: Study use only. Verify against the FCOM of your operator and aircraft before relying on it.

question: In AUTO, at what cabin altitude do the passenger oxygen mask doors open?

options.text: Above 9 550 ft
Above 10 000 ft
Above 18 000 ft
Above 14 000 ft

explanation: MASK MAN ON opens them at any cabin altitude.
reference: Study use only. Verify against the FCOM of your operator and aircraft before relying on it.

question: When does the white PASSENGER SYS ON light go out?

options.text: When the cabin altitude falls below 14 000 ft
When the OXYGEN TIMER RESET is pushed on the maintenance panel
After 15 minutes
After landing

explanation: It comes on when the mask doors are actuated.
reference: Study use only. Verify against the FCOM of your operator and aircraft before relying on it.

question: What does a white OFF on the CREW SUPPLY pushbutton show?

options.text: The crew oxygen bottle is empty
The crew oxygen supply valve is closed
The masks are in use
The passenger oxygen is off

explanation: ON opens the valve and supplies low-pressure oxygen to the cockpit masks.
reference: Study use only. Verify against the FCOM of your operator and aircraft before relying on it.
